messages.author: 5900eadecec2d82d
messages.subject: Re: baffling problem with mean cluster size calculations in
parts:
Hi Joel, list,

Thanks for getting back to me offline with a copy of your project file.
It's a bug in the CDS/MCDS engine. It occurs when you use different
truncation distances for estimating mean cluster size than the
truncation for estimating the detection function. I will fix it for the
next release of Distance. Meanwhile, you can estimate mean cluster size
for the appropriate subset of data outside of Distance, and then enter
it in to the software as another multiplier. The other solution would
be to use the default method for dealing with size bias, which is the
regression of ln(cluster size) against estimated g(x). Anyway,
apologies for the bug.

- len
